players.product: batch ALD/LPCVD deposition systems for DRAM

quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2027 revenue of JPY 75.4 billion set a new record high for a single quarter, up 46% year-over-year, with adjusted operating income up 59% year-over-year to JPY 17.4 billion and gross profit margin of 40.7% (up 1.3 points QoQ on higher production utilization). By application, DRAM sales increased 158% year-over-year and logic foundry sales 82%, while NAND sales fell 34% year-over-year but climbed 84% sequentially. Sales to non-China manufacturers rose 75% year-over-year; sales to Chinese manufacturers slipped 3% year-over-year but rose 18% from the prior quarter, a recovery from the fourth-quarter low.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 revenue JPY 75.4 billion (record, +46% YoY); adjusted OP JPY 17.4 billion (+59% YoY); gross margin 40.7%; DRAM +158% YoY, logic foundry +82% YoY, NAND +84% QoQ; non-China +75% YoY

quarterly_data.signal: First quarter orders received totaled approximately JPY 140 billion, exceeding initial forecasts by about JPY 67 billion. The increase was particularly significant for DRAM for China, as well as for NAND sold to non-China and China, and this strong demand is expected to continue into the second quarter. Chinese demand is described as increasingly strong across major logic foundry, DRAM and NAND - not one-off, expected to continue at a minimum through this fiscal year and next, with medium and small emerging chip manufacturers also stronger and some companies announcing new factories.
quarterly_data.figure: Q1 orders ~JPY 140 billion, ~JPY 67 billion above initial forecast

quarterly_data.signal: Full-year FY March 2027 guidance raised: revenue up 21% from the prior forecast to JPY 340 billion (+45% year-on-year), adjusted operating income up 42% to JPY 86 billion (+81% year-on-year), adjusted net income up 40% to JPY 60 billion; first half revised up 6% to JPY 161.0 billion (+37% YoY). Gross profit margin raised one point to 43% on product mix. Annual dividend raised JPY 18 to JPY 65 per share. CY2026 WFE growth outlook raised about 10 percentage points to over 25%, around $140 billion (from 15% growth and $120 billion-$125 billion), and CY2027 is expected to grow about 20% with possible further upside. The midterm revenue target of JPY 330 billion is now expected to be achieved in March 2027, two years ahead of schedule, with the 30%-or-higher adjusted operating margin target aimed for March 2028 via operating leverage, richer product mix (NAND CapEx strengthening), and pricing revisions. Non-China revenue is forecast to grow 49% (NAND +95%, DRAM +39%, logic and foundry +89%); China revenue +37% year-on-year with the share around 33%.
quarterly_data.figure: FY March 2027 revenue raised 21% to JPY 340 billion (+45% YoY); adjusted OP JPY 86 billion (+81% YoY); WFE CY2026 over 25% growth to ~$140 billion; midterm JPY 330 billion target hit two years ahead of schedule

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity utilization is expected at an average of 70%-80% in the first half and over 80% in the second half of March 2027, higher next fiscal year; production lead time is currently around eight months. Current capacity secures the JPY 340 billion revenue forecast, and capacity is being expanded for March 2028 and beyond: warehouse space at the Tonami plant is being converted to clean room, newly acquired land next to Tonami is being evaluated for rapid expansion, production engineer recruitment is ramping, and shifts (currently 1.5) can be increased. Monthly unit production capacity is targeted to reach 2.5 times the March 2025 level in 10 years. Investment timing has advanced about two years versus the WFE view at the start of the year; suppliers are also preparing capacity and are not currently a bottleneck.
quarterly_data.figure: Utilization 70%-80% H1, over 80% H2; lead time around eight months; monthly unit capacity targeted at 2.5 times the March 2025 level in 10 years

quarterly_data.signal: Growth catalysts: GAA sales were about JPY 5 billion in Q1 and are expected at over JPY 20 billion for FY March 2027. Advanced packaging revenue, JPY 6 billion in FY March 2026, is now expected at JPY 15 billion in FY March 2027 (Q1 was JPY 4.5 billion) - a significant upward revision from the JPY 6 billion prior plan, driven by both rising customer CapEx and additional POR wins for its film deposition technology. In NAND, demand-supply is not fully adjusted - memory players are allocating clean room to DRAM while NAND wafer output needs to increase - so greenfield NAND investments are expected to resume, which converts all of Kokusai's PORs to sales and is broadly favorable. In DRAM, the D1C transition is complete and D1D is progressing. NAND sales could approach record highs, and DRAM plus NAND plus advanced packaging support growth above WFE (targeting more than a 20% sales increase).
quarterly_data.figure: GAA JPY 5 billion in Q1, over JPY 20 billion FY March 2027; advanced packaging raised to JPY 15 billion FY March 2027 from JPY 6 billion in FY March 2026
